title: 第472章 秦氏六脉脚下之路第471章 天庭来人插手
slug: 九脉被夺我以魔种证无敌
lines: 巨鲸帮的帮主郑坤，给出的消息，让秦逸意识到，那群能让天极教，大河剑派，以及千岛宗都恭恭敬敬的人，定然是来自天庭。
前段时间，他就通过东方澜的爷爷的来信，得知有天庭使者，降临了此界，待在南宫家族。
只不过，知道这个消息的人，暂时还不多。
当然，风妗显然是知道的，她此刻也已经猜到了。
风妗的表情，很快就恢复了正常，道：“接下来的比武，在混乱海域实力最强的截天岛进行。”
“先在这边休息一天，明日再出发前往截天岛。”
郑坤立刻给星空殿的众人，安排住处。
住处安排好后。
风妗将秦逸，沈舟，周婷，以及田不归，还有几个比较核心的成员，召至身前。
“郑坤所说的人，应该是来自天庭。”
风妗用着平静的语气，抛出了这么一个重磅消息。
此话一出，在场除了秦逸，其余人都瞬间就瞪大了眼睛，极为震惊。
秦逸也赶紧跟着，一副非常惊讶的样子。
风妗继续道：“天庭的人来了，隐世家族应该也有人会跟着他们来。”
“也就意味着，天极教，大河剑派，千岛宗，以及部分隐世家族的人，将以天庭为核心，结成同盟。”
“接下来的比武，会对我们非常不利。”
“但这场比武，又不得不参加，所以，秦逸，沈舟，周婷，你们三人记住，比武开始后，能战则战，若事不可为，万万莫要勉强。”
三人拱手，齐声道：“是！”
风妗继续道：“另外，天庭即便来人，实力也有限。”
“因为此界早已破碎，规则秩序不全，真正的神级，根本无法降临。”
秦逸目光一闪，问道：“真正的神级，不能降临？那为何，魔族却想着要接引一个魔神降临此界？”
这个问题抛出来，顿时便让众人都觉得不对劲。
一直以来，魔族召唤魔神降临的事，都宛如悬在无数人头顶上的一把刀！
可神级强者无法降临这个破碎的世界。
那人族的这些强者们，为何还这么紧张？
风妗道：“因为魔族的计划一旦成功，沟通了魔神，魔神大概率会斩去神级之力，自降为圆满圣王。”
“一个圆满圣王级别的魔族，拥有魔神的记忆，这对此界来说，依旧是一场巨大的灾难。”
这话倒是解释得通。
但秦逸总觉得……似乎还是有一些不太对劲。
但风妗已经做出了回应，加上现在的重心，应该是即将在截天岛举办的比武，所以，秦逸便没有再追问下去。
风妗交代了几句，便让众人退下，但却单独喊住了秦逸。
“风尊莫非还有事情叮嘱？”
秦逸拱手问道。
风妗嗯了一声，道：“我听说，你之前从星空殿离开时，殿主给了你一个锦囊？”
秦逸目光一闪，点头道：“确有此事，殿主交代，若是陷入了绝境，便将锦囊打开。”
“所以，至今我也还未打开过锦囊。”
风妗点了点头，道：“天庭使者，跟南宫家族走得很近，你与南宫家族有仇怨，你被针对的可能性最大。”
“其实，天庭的人，以及隐世家族的人，最近会将手伸入荒海，在我们的预料之中。”
“毕竟，前段时间那事，动静太大，镇荒印的波动，瞒不住有心之人。”
“所以老身想不明白一件事，你大师兄，为何一定要你来这里？”
“你身上有殿主给的锦囊，此事也是你大师兄告诉老身的，可即便殿主的锦囊有妙用，但这对你来说，依旧太冒险了！”
content_en:
The news given by Zheng Kun, the leader of the Giant Whale Gang, made Qin Yi realize that the group of people who could make Tianji Sect, Dahe Sword Sect, and Thousand Island Sect respect him must be from Heaven.
Some time ago, he learned through a letter from Dongfang Lan's grandfather that a messenger from heaven had come to this world and stayed in the Nangong family.
However, not many people know the news yet.
Of course, Feng Jin obviously knew, and she had already guessed it at this moment.
Feng Jin's expression quickly returned to normal and said: "The next competition will be held on Jietian Island, which is the strongest in the Chaotic Sea."
"Let's rest here for a day and then set off to Jietian Island tomorrow."
Zheng Kun immediately arranged accommodation for everyone in the Starry Sky Palace.
After the accommodation is arranged.
Feng Jin summoned Qin Yi, Shen Zhou, Zhou Ting, Wada Bugui, and a few more core members to her side.
"The person Zheng Kun mentioned should be from heaven."
Feng Jin used a calm tone to reveal such a bombshell news.
As soon as these words came out, everyone present except Qin Yi's eyes widened in shock.
Qin Yi quickly followed, looking very surprised.
Feng Jin continued: "The people from the Heavenly Court are coming, and there should be people from the Hidden World Family following them."
"This means that the Tianji Sect, the Dahe Sword Sect, the Thousand Island Sect, and some people from the hidden families will form an alliance with Tianting as the core."
"The next competition will be very detrimental to us."
"But we have to participate in this competition, so Qin Yi, Shen Zhou, Zhou Ting, the three of you remember that after the competition begins, fight if you can. If something cannot be done, don't force it."
The three people cupped their hands and said in unison: "Yes!"
Feng Jin continued: "In addition, even if someone comes from Heaven, their strength is limited."
"Because this world has been broken for a long time, the rules and order are incomplete, and the true god level cannot come at all."
Qin Yi's eyes flashed and he asked: "Can't a true god come? Then why do the demons want to bring a demon god to this world?"
When this question was raised, everyone immediately felt that something was wrong.
All this time, the demon clan summoning the demon god to come has been like a knife hanging over the heads of countless people!
But a god-level powerhouse cannot come to this broken world.
So why are these strong men from the human race so nervous?
Feng Jin said: "Because once the demon clan's plan is successful and the demon god is communicated with, the demon god will most likely cut off his god-level power and reduce himself to the Holy King of Perfection."
"A demon who has reached the level of a perfect holy king and possesses the memory of a demon god is still a huge disaster to this world."
This does make sense.
But Qin Yi always felt... there seemed to be something not quite right.
But Feng Jin had already responded, and the current focus should be on the upcoming competition on Jietian Island, so Qin Yi didn't ask any more questions.
Feng Jin explained a few words and asked everyone to leave, but she called Qin Yi alone.
"Does Feng Zun still have something to say?"
Qin Yi cupped his hands and asked.
Feng Jin hummed and said, "I heard that when you left the Starry Sky Palace, the master of the palace gave you a tips bag?"
Qin Yi's eyes flashed, and he nodded: "It is indeed true. The master of the palace has told me that if he is in a desperate situation, he will open the bag of tips."
"So, I haven't opened my bag of tips yet."
Feng Jin nodded and said: "The messenger from heaven is very close to the Nangong family. You have a grudge against the Nangong family, so you are most likely to be targeted."
"Actually, it is within our expectation that people from the Heavenly Court and the Hidden World Family will reach out into the deserted sea recently."
"After all, there was too much noise about what happened some time ago, and the fluctuations of the Desolate Seal cannot be hidden from those who are interested."
"So I can't understand one thing. Why do you, senior brother, have to have you come here?"
"You have a tip bag given by the Palace Master, and your senior brother told me about this. But even if the Palace Master's tip bag is useful, it is still too risky for you!"
title_en: Chapter 472: The road at the foot of Qin's Six Meridians Chapter 471: Someone from Heaven intervenes
